value.a: THE ADJACENT GATE TAUGHT THE ORDER: the orient door refused the un-cast claim, so /sorted precedes /chart for any stone whose berths claim their ticket — a liturgy fact discovered by physics, not designed.

JURISDICTION IS THE CROSSING, NOT THE COMPONENT: constrain sketched FILTERS registration; survey measured that the promotion sweep has no crossing context and would retro-red every pre-chain component (tooth 1) — so the check lives beside FILTERS but is called from the chokepoint's BUILDME entry, exactly as the census is called from its PROVEME exit. The bounds' constraints outranked the bounds' mechanism sketch, on the record.

ONE DIRECT CLAIM IS THE CHAIN-CHECK: a validate berth on disk means the whole preamble held at its doors, so the gate reads one ticket field instead of walking six refs — the doors already paid for the walk (Law 1 at the gate).

A GATE CAN BE BORN GATED: this stone's own chart chain claims this stone's own ticket, so the first crossing the entry gate would ever have gated is the crossing that built it — replayed green at live fire.
